notes.title: Update v3.0.0 | Lola Cow is here
notes.notes:
- THE COMPANY INCOMING TRANSMISSION -

Greetings Astronauts.

A new update has been pushed to the My Last 20 mission, new the Moo Cow Chaos zone has changed, the Arcade Mode is now more.... random?? And a new Astronaut called Lola has been recruited.

Please read the patch notes carefully.... 

Best regards,
THE COMPANY

____ TRANSMISSION ENDED____


Map Changes

 The Moo Cow map has been modified, now has more room to move around and avoid those cows.
 The Arcade mode now starts with a random chaos zone instead of Meteorix all the time.
 The Arcade Maps has been modified.


Player Stats Balance
We noticed that some of you like to play with certain character but due it's difficulty/feeling you went back to the "vieja confiable", so we changed the based speed of all characters, the min speed will be 17, base speed will be 18 and max speed 19.

New Skins coming
Due some tech issues we couldn't deliver the new skins but Lola is here with new death animations.
Some skins has been changed slightly and added some animations to ensure its quality.

UI changes
The config and the skins menu is now better and feels more intuitive. 
We revamped the death screen with new information and more clarity.


We are preparing for the new Leaderboard system so stay tunned and again thanks for all the amazing support and keep playing!

notes.title: Update v2.3.0 | Kalaka
notes.notes:
INCOMING TRANSMISSION FROM THE COMPANY

Greetings Astronauts. 

The company has pushed a new set of rule into the My Last 20 Mission, some of you now have different suits that behave differently in the chaos zone. A new death counter will appear each time you try the mission reminding you how many time you have failed us.... Anyway good luck out there, just make sure to bring me those space tokens.

---- TRANSMISSION ENDED ----


New character stats
Each character now have different speed, lives, shields, hit box and space token multiplier.  Thise makes the gameplay more dynamic for some that loves suffering or just want to complete certain challenge without worring much the asteroids.

Death Counter
Each time you enter into a any game mode you'll see a new death counter that will always remind you that you are a failure.....

New Skins

 Kalaka
 Lala (will be released later this week)
 Jeff (will be released later this week)


New arcade maps
We added 2 new arcade maps to make the gameplay will more *addictive* and less *tiring*

Windowed mode
We noticed that some of you play My Last 20 during other gaming sessions or between loading screens so... we now you can play in windows mode just press "F11" on your keyboard to switch between windowed and fullscreen.

notes.title: Small Patch | v2.2.0
notes.notes:
First of all thanks for playing our game, more than 1.5k astronauts and more than 21h average playtime! That's alot for being our first game in Steam. ❤️

New Skins
Now the important part: The company has hired new Astronauts:

 Ducknaut Skin (Founder's Pack)
 Captain Pus Skin (Tentalis Mission)
 Rob Skins (Founder's Pack)


Language
We improved the English and Spanish Translations, also Russian is now available, please report to us if you find any issue with these translations at contact@droidgamestd.com.

Arcade Mode Balance
We balance the Tentalis phase of the Arcade Mode, we felt that was a bit impossible sometimes.

notes.title: Update V 2.1 | THE COMPANY LOVE Y'ALL
notes.notes:
Gameplay

General:

 Space Tokens size decresed.
Note: to avoid visual noise we decreased the size of the space tokens and also this makes some challenges harder to complete.
 Player movement has been blocked before the level starts.
 [Bug] Now the level restart properly after you die before hitting 1 second (really?)
 [Bug] Tentacles hit box has been fixed.
 Tentacles behave diffently from each other.


Arcade Mode:


 Random Chaos Zone Generator: Now each 20 seconds you’ll be teleported to another chaos zone. Each chaos zone has it’s own enemies and difficulty.
 New Chaos Zones were added to arcade mode. Each time you enter to an arcade match you’ll get a random Premade Chaos Zone design.
 The progressive difficulty has been improved and now is easier to test and adjust.


Challenges


 The challenge's current progress stats (current_val/goal_val) now update live, you don’t have to reload the game to see the current progress.
 New Arcade Mode challenges


Others

 Fixing the stars respawn (yes, they had a bug….).
 New skin sorting.
 Music and Sound FX settings added.
 (Steam) The DLC skins now have a button to purchase the Founders Pack directly from the Steam Overlay. Please adopt Emma the Orange Cat 🐱.
 New Mission’s Art.
 Russian in-game translation improved.
 Easter Eggs added :D.
